dimensions.name: Purpose and principles
dimensions.definition: do the instructions preserve the stated philosophy and the skill’s role?

dimensions.name: Consistency
dimensions.definition: can applicable rules be followed together? Check terminology, conditions, exceptions, and examples.

dimensions.name: Requirements
dimensions.definition: identify applicable requirements omitted or changed, and obligations added without justification. Do not require one skill to cover the entire methodology.

dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.definition: flag ambiguities or missing information that could change an important decision. Separate proven defects, missing context, and optional improvements.

rules.disagree: report both values and flag for human arbitration

context.title: Conceptual audit of a methodological skill
context.idea: Refine the skill by checking its coherence with its purpose and philosophy, and its consistency with applicable requirements.
context.constraints: Review concepts and requirements, not software development. Preserve the author's intent. Use the authority and scope stated in the supplied documents; ask when precedence is unclear. Propose local corrections, not a full rewrite. Do not require code, tests, empirical performance metrics, or empirical proof of philosophical commitments.
